2178-2380-6797.easyPrerequisites:
Bloodline Keeper // Lord of Lineage doesn't have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff is attached to Bloodline Keeper // Lord of Lineage.
2178-2380-6797.description:
Activate Bloodline Keeper // Lord of Lineage by tapping it, creating a creature token.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Bloodline Keeper // Lord of Lineage triggers due to its ability granted to it by Thornbite Staff, untapping Bloodline Keeper // Lord of Lineage.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train and causing it to become a creature until end of turn
Repeat.

5254-6495-8122.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
You don't control an Army, or the only Army you do control is the creature with power 4 or greater.
5254-6495-8122.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing another creature with power 4 or greater. If you control an Army, ensure to sacrifice that creature.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Orc Army creature token and putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
5254-6495-8122.notes:
The Orc Army will become a 5/5 due to the counters and the buff provided by The Muckslinger Gang.
If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

728-6103-6105.description:
Cast Illusion of Choice by paying {U}, causing you to choose how players vote this turn and drawing a card.
Cast Magister of Worth by paying {4}{W}{B}.
When Magister of Worth enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Magister of Worth and any number of other creatures.
Resolve the Magister of Worth trigger, having each player vote for grace, returning all creatures from graveyards to the battlefield.
Resolve all abilities from step 4.
Repeat from 3.

147-2171-4247.easyPrerequisites: There's a nonlegendary creature card in your graveyard.
147-2171-4247.description:
Cast Persist by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Persist.
Holding priority, activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, giving Bloodthrone Vampire +2/+2 until end of turn.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Persist
Resolve the Persist copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1724-4050-6972.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Sekki.
When Sekki dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

527-542-5434.notablePrerequisites:
You have a creature card in hand that can be cast using only colored mana.
Selvala can tap to produce at least {1}{G}{G}{G} plus enough mana to cast the other creature card.
527-542-5434.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{G}{G}{G} plus enough mana to cast a creature card from your hand.
Cast a creature card by paying its mana cost.
Tidespout Tyrant triggers, returning Selvala from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Selvala by paying {1}{G}{G}.
Tidespout Tyrant triggers, returning the creature cast in step 2 from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

206-3490-3755-7075.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
206-3490-3755-7075.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

2724-3080-4608-7334.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block and kill The Neutrinos.
You control at least four enchantments.
2724-3080-4608-7334.description:
Cast Exchange of Words by paying {1}{U}{U}.
When Exchange of Words enters, it triggers, exchanging the text boxes of itself and Wormfang Manta.
Declare The Neutrinos as an attacker, attacking a player who cannot kill it in combat.
When The Neutrinos attacks, it triggers, exiling and returning Exchange of Words tapped and attacking.
When Exchange of Words leaves the battlefield, its ability from Wormfang Manta's textbox triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
When Exchange of Words enters, it triggers, exchanging the text boxes of itself and Wormfang Manta.
Repeat from step 3 each turn.

3812-6287-7308.notablePrerequisites:
Mimeoplasm does not have summoning sickness.
Simic Ragworm and Mona Lisa are exiled by Mimeoplasm.
3812-6287-7308.description:
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Mona Lisa.
Activate Mimeoplasm by tapping it, adding an amount of {U} equal to its power.
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Simic Ragworm.
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

339-677-6798-7297.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

3259-5768-7297.notablePrerequisites:
Origin of the Hidden Ones has exactly two lore counters on it.
You control at least one Assassin that does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-5768-7297.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Origin of the Hidden Ones triggers, putting a lore counter on it.
Origin of the Hidden Ones' third chapter ability triggers, causing you to create an Assassin token whenever an Assassin attacks this turn and sacrifice Origin of the Hidden Ones.
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached, and at least one Assassin if the creature with Breath of Fury attached isn't an Assassin, as attackers.
Origin of the Hidden Ones triggers, creating a 1/1 Assassin creature token that's tapped and attacking.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Assassin token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1563-3899-4927-6753.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

141-4050-5117.description:
Cast Undying Malice by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Undying Malice, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Undying Malice.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

3375-5078-6918.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

3734-4375-4659.description:
Cast Technomancer by paying {5}{B}{B}.
When Technomancer enters, it triggers, causing you to mill three cards and return Phyrexian Metamorph from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
When Phyrexian Metamorph enters, it triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Phyrexian Metamorph.
Resolve the Phyrexian Metamorph trigger, causing you to mill three cards and return Phyrexian Metamorph from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
Repeat from step 3.

560-2034-4593-5870.description:
Activate Mite Overseer by paying {3}{W/P}, creating two creature tokens.
When the creature tokens enter the battlefield, Guide of Souls triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life and get {E}{E}
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
560-2034-4593-5870.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the creature tokens

261-1981-4416-6740.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 3.
You control two untapped Soldiers.
261-1981-4416-6740.description:
Declare Phyrexian Vindicator as an attacker.
Holding priority, activate Catapult Squad by tapping two Soldiers, attempting to deal 2 damage to Phyrexian Vindicator.
The damage is prevented due to Phyrexian Vindicator's replacement effect. Phyrexian Vindicator triggers, dealing 2 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating two 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
When the Soldiers enter the battlefield, Suture Priest triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1872-2018-4053.description:
Activate Composite Golem by sacrificing it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
When Composite Golem dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Composite Golem from your graveyard to the battlefield without a flying counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

933-3492-3609-4112.description:
Activate Coretapper's first ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Coretapper's second ability by sacrificing it, putting two charge counters on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Conjurer's Closet triggers, blinking Sharuum.
When Sharuum enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Coretapper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat each turn.

1429-2099-5402-5929.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1429-2099-5402-5929.description:
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies,  its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Invasion of Kaldheim // Pyre of the World Tree

1356-4231-5078-5660-5924.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one land card in hand.
1356-4231-5078-5660-5924.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield on top of your library.
Activate Pyre of the World Tree by discarding a land card.
Pyre of the World Tree triggers, exiling Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library with the ability to play it until end of turn.
Resolve the Pyre of the World Tree ability, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from exile by paying {1}.
Rocco's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness and creating a Food token, a Clue token and a Treasure token
Evolution Witness triggers, returning a land card from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

330-5346-5365-5366.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Clue or Food.
Your commander is on the battlefield under your control.
330-5346-5365-5366.description:
Activate your commander by paying {1} and sacrificing a Clue or Food.
Crime Novelist and Jenny Flint trigger, as well as Lonis' second ability if the sacrificed artifact was a Clue.
Resolve the Crime Novelist trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and adding {R}.
Resolve the Lonis trigger, if applicable, putting a +1/+1 counter on any other creature you control.
Resolve the Jenny Flint trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lonis.
Lonis' first ability triggers, causing you to create a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: with a kick counter on it

249-2103-2276.notablePrerequisites:
Zethi does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill Zethi.
249-2103-2276.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your combat phase, and declare Zethi as an attacker.
Zethi triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to cast a copy of Said.
Resolve Said, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

394-1570-5010.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a non-Human creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
394-1570-5010.description:
Cause a non-Human creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
Sage of the Falls triggers, causing you to mill four cards, return Golgari Thug from your graveyard to your hand, and discard Golgari Thug.
Desecrated Tomb triggers, creating a 1/1 Bat creature token.
Repeat from step 2.

511-2034-3517-4868.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with at least three spore counters on it.
511-2034-3517-4868.description:
Activate a creature you control by removing two spore counters from it, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
The Saproling enters the battlefield, triggering Tainted Observer.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Saproling, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Tainted Observer trigger, causing you to pay {2} to put two spore counters on any creature you control.
Repeat.

382-4013-4659.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Basilica Shepherd.
Basilica Shepherd enters the battlefield, creating two 1/1 Phyrexian Mite artifact creature tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing two Phyrexian Mites, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
